description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlService component, verifying behaviors such as acknowledgment, application state setting, and ping functionality within the control server context.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment is false when no control has been added.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Checks that setting application state does not occur without a control being added.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithUnknownControlId
methods.description: Ensures acknowledgment fails when an unknown control ID is used.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment fails after the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Checks that setting application state fails if the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldAck
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment succeeds when the control is properly added and acknowledged.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationState
methods.description: Tests that the application state can be set successfully for an added control.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationStateForNewControl
methods.description: Verifies setting application state immediately after creating a new control.

methods.name: shouldPing
methods.description: Checks that the ping operation works correctly after control creation.
